hero.heading: Technology to better your business.
hero.body: Haki Tools helps Charleston-area businesses launch websites, upgrade their online presence, and automate the busy work, so you can focus on what actually matters.

statement.statement: The right tools don't just look good. They do real *work* while you're busy running things.

services.heading: Four clear paths. All built around your business.
services.body: Every project starts with a conversation. These are the ways most businesses work with us. Wherever you land, the process is clear and focused on real results.

outcomes.heading: What good technology actually does for your business.

process.heading: How we build it together.
process.body: This isn't something we throw over the wall. Every step involves you, from the first conversation to the day you launch.

faq.heading: Questions you probably have.
faq.body: If something's not covered here, bring it up when you fill out the form.

contact.heading: Tell me what you're building.
contact.body: Fill in what you can. This is low-pressure: we'll figure out the details together on a short call. No commitment required.
trust: No sales pressure, just a conversation

success.heading: You're in.
success.body: Expect a reply within 24–48 hours to set up a quick call. We'll go over what you want to build and see if it's a good fit. No commitment required.

contact.privacyNote: Your information is used only to follow up about your project. No spam, no lists.
